meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会查询你指定时间范围内的会议记录，读取相关会议纪要，汇总成结构化报告（单日概览或多日周报）；如果你要求，它还能把报告生成或追加到云文档。
howto.when: 当你说出“整理会议纪要”“生成会议周报”“回顾一段时间会议内容”等需求，或提到“今天”“这周”等时间并询问会议时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要，生成周报
say.note: 会查询本周会议并汇总成周报

say.text: 今天开了哪些会？列个概览
say.note: 会输出今日会议列表及纪要链接

say.text: 把过去一个月的会议纪要整理成文档
say.note: 会拆分时间范围分批查询再汇总

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude queries meeting records in a user-specified time range, reads related meeting minutes, and compiles them into a structured report (single-day overview or multi-day/weekly summary). If asked, it can also create or append the report to a cloud document.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to organize meeting minutes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review meeting content over a period—e.g., mentions "this week" or "today" while asking about meetings.

say_en.text: Organize this week's meeting minutes into a weekly report.
say_en.note: Claude will query this week's meetings and summarize them.

say_en.text: Which meetings happened today? List an overview.
say_en.note: It outputs today's meeting list with minute links.

say_en.text: Compile all meeting minutes from the past month into a doc.
say_en.note: It splits the range into monthly batches and summarizes.
